lead_raw_text:
The structure of LaAu crystallizes in the cubic space group Pm-3m (No. 221), with a unit cell containing two atoms—one Au and one La—distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Au and La centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each, at a uniform distance of 3.1679 Å; the Au centers coordinate to 4 Au and 8 La neighbors, while La centers coordinate to 12 Au neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional, comprising a single connected component of two sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate that 12-vertex Au and La coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
